title: Thompson Sampling for Infinite-Horizon Discounted Decision Processes
abstract: arXiv:2405.08253v4 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: This paper develops a framework for learning in discounted infinite-horizon Markov decision processes (MDPs) with Borel state and action spaces, whose rewards and transitions depend on an unknown parameter.To analyze sampling-based adaptive learning algorithms in this setting, we introduce a canonical probability space that explicitly incorporates sampled parameters into the history of the process. As a performance criterion, we adopt the per-period suboptimality gap used in discounted-MDP regret analysis and specialize it to our parametrized Bayesian setting. Since this quantity captures the remaining loss in future performance from the current period onward, we refer to it as residual regret. We use the expected residual regret to connect discounted-MDP regret analysis with asymptotic discount optimality from adaptive control and the temporal-difference error perspective from reinforcement learning. We then focus on Thompson

translated_title: 无限时域折扣决策过程的汤普森采样
translated_abstract: 本文为具有Borel状态空间与动作空间、且奖励和转移依赖于未知参数的折扣无限时域马尔可夫决策过程（MDP）建立了一个学习框架。为了分析该设定下基于采样的自适应学习算法，我们引入了一个标准概率空间，将采样得到的参数显式地纳入过程的历史之中。作为性能准则，我们采用折扣MDP遗憾分析中使用的每周期次优性差距，并将其专门化到我们的参数化贝叶斯设定中。由于该量刻画了从当前周期起未来性能中的剩余损失，我们将其称为“残余遗憾”（residual regret）。我们利用期望残余遗憾，将折扣MDP遗憾分析与自适应控制中的渐近折扣最优性以及强化学习中的时序差分误差视角联系起来。随后，我们聚焦于汤普森采样……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文为参数化折扣无限时域MDP提出了一个学习框架，创新性地引入“残余遗憾”作为性能准则，将折扣MDP遗憾分析与自适应控制的渐近折扣最优性及强化学习的时序差分误差视角联系起来，从而为汤普森采样类自适应学习算法提供了分析工具。
en_tdlr: This paper develops a learning framework for parametrized discounted infinite-horizon MDPs and introduces "residual regret" as a novel performance criterion that bridges discounted-MDP regret analysis with asymptotic discount optimality from adaptive control and the temporal-difference error perspective from reinforcement learning, providing analytical tools for Thompson sampling-based adaptive learning algorithms.
